profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary:
I graduated from University of California,Davis in June 2014 with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering. I have been exposed to both software and hardware; I have studied data structures and algorithms, implemented word searches and matching in C++, added features to an OS(Minix), programmed FPGAs and microcontrollers, drawn circuits, designed finite state machines, layout VLSI, and ran simulations in Cadence. Though I ultimately went down the software route, I still maintain interest in hardware.


Programming: Java, Javascript, HTML, XML, SQL

Technologies: SAML 2.0, Swagger, RESTful API, JSP, AJAX, Apache Ant, Apache Tomcat, JUnit, Selenium, FitNese, Jenkins, Apache Velocity, Git, Gradle

positions.title: Software Engineer - Product Development
positions.description:
• As a software engineer, I gather requirements, design and develop features for Guidewire’s all-in-one Java cloud solution, InsuranceNow, under the Agile Scrum methodology.

• Designed and implemented a Java based tool/framework for modifying customer source code to reduce upgrade cost, used by developers and upgrade implementation engineers.

• Designed, implemented, and documented a set of systematic procedures to convert existing HTML layout to a newly designed layout, that needed to apply to hundreds of HTML files, and customer projects.

• Tasked to improve CSS/HTML knowledge to drive initial UI/UX refresh effort, while appropriate resources were being allocated.

• Implemented a framework to collect transactional data used to do SLA analysis with Sumo Logic.

• Implemented and integrated globalization capabilities for handling multi-locale dates using ICU library.

• Analyzed and reduced a batch process’s run time by over half by implementing multi-threading.

• Analyzed and reduced a batch process run time by over half by optimizing code and implementing multi-threading.

• Reduced a page’s load time by over half by batching multiple database queries.

• Migrated existing RPC API to Swagger framework following REST API design.

• Interview candidates.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Product Development
positions.description:
• Develop new features and improve existing features for ISCS's core enterprise insurance software. SurePower Innovation.

• Implemented and integrate SAML 2.0 Web Browser Single Sign-On Profile as an Identity Provider and Service Provider.

• Refactored an existing payment service feature to use Java Interface to allow for implementations of external payment services from multiple vendors.

• Write and manage selenium test scripts as well as JUnit tests.

• Write release notes.

positions.title: Implementation Engineer - Professional Services
positions.description:
• As an implementation engineer, I work on project teams of three to five people to configure, implement and transform our enterprise software, under Agile Scrum methodology, to fit the business needs of our customers.

•Design new and modify existing base UI: adding/removing fields, reorganizing layout, prefilling and manipulating input values, and dynamically changing display through Javascript, Apache Velocity, AJAX, and HTML.

•Write new and modify existing services in Java to manipulate XML data structures that drive changes in application functionalities.

•Implemented a SOAP base interface that pushes our system’s claims data to a third party claims application; designed and implemented XML configuration and SOAP body templates; designed and implemented system rules, service triggers, and system notifications to satisfy interface and customer requirements; wrote and documented recipe on interface implementation and data mapping.

•Communicate with project managers, business analysts and customers to identify requirements and generate solutions based on application capabilities.

•Use tools such as Eclipse, MySQL, Jenkins, Apache Tomcat, CVS Repository, Sharepoint, and OpenAir.

positions.title: Implementation Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•Maintained and updated Selenium test script to accommodate for application UI changes.

•Upgrade and refactor application and do regression testing.

projects.title: Multi-Processor Data Sorting Engine
projects.description: This project consists of the design and layout of a chip which contains an array of 9 processors that sorts a stream of 9 unsigned 8-bit numbers at very high throughputs.

projects.title: Senior Design Project
projects.description: We created a system on chip parallel to serial communication with configurable protocol using Cadence. As the team leader, I arranged the meetings and we outlined the timelines and milestones to meet project goals and deadlines. We identified the components of this project such as SRAM, LDO voltage regulator, clock divider, level shifter, counter, shift register, and master controller as a team. We also determined the featured protocols of the project to be SPI, UART, and I2C as a team. We validated the schematic and debugged the circuit to ensure that our integrated circuit design is functional. We also completed a market analysis on our design.
